articles.titleCn: 停止和调度LLM裁判小组
articles.abstractCn: LLM评估流程通常包含众多候选裁判：通用LLM裁判提示、奖励模型、安全分类器、置信度变体以及特定任务的验证器。部署问题不仅在于哪个裁判最佳，还在于应在哪些示例上调用哪些裁判，以及何时停止裁判小组的构建。我们将裁判小组设计问题表述为基于角色条件分配问题。通过从少量标记审计集、声明切片和裁判成本出发，该方法估计目标相对角色：副本不提供任何条件信息，补充者可提升全局裁判小组，而专家仅对切片有帮助。这些角色引出策略：舍弃副本，全局添加补充者，条件路由专家，并在验证收益低于阈值时停止。在推理、代码、安全、偏好、奖励模型、摘要和数学审计中，该方法与单一裁判、扁平裁判小组、匹配多样性启发式、全调用堆叠、可靠性陪审团和节俭级联进行了比较。结果形成裁判调用规则图：在可部署切片上路由专家，在饱和验证器状态下停止，当其风险收益值得成本时保留广谱集合，并忽略条件副本。输出为可复用、可审计的下一批评估调用计划。

articles.title: LoRA-GA$^2$: Low Rank Adaptation with Multi-step Gradient Adaptive Alignment
articles.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a prominent fine-tuning method for large models, achieving competitive performance with reduced memory overhead. However, a persistent performance gap remains between LoRA and full fine-tuning. Recent studies have sought to narrow this gap by employing one-step gradient approximations of pretrained weights to align LoRA updates with the principal directions or intrinsic dimensionalities of full fine-tuning updates. Nevertheless, these approaches fail to capture the full dynamics of the gradients. In this paper, we propose LoRA-GA$^2$, an effective fine-tuning algorithm that fully leverages multi-step gradient information. Specifically, we introduce a lightweight probe for multi-step gradients of pretrained weights that incurs no additional GPU memory cost and only marginal time overhead. We further employ a spectrum-aware, importance-based rank allocation and optimal initialization derived from multi-step gradients. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that LoRA-GA$^2$ consistently outperforms existing LoRA variants while preserving the efficiency advantages of vanilla LoRA. For instance, LoRA-GA$^2$ surpasses the leading baseline by an average of 0.66 points on the GLUE benchmark, and outperforms the strongest baseline by 1.03 points on GSM8K and 0.87 points on HumanEval, respectively.
articles.titleCn: LoRA-GA$^2$：多步梯度自适应对齐的低秩适配
articles.abstractCn: 低秩适配（LoRA）是一种针对大型模型的突出微调方法，在降低内存开销的同时实现了具有竞争力的性能。然而，LoRA与完整微调之间存在持续的性能差距。近期研究通过采用预训练权重的单步梯度近似来对齐LoRA更新与完整微调更新的主方向或内在维度，试图缩小这一差距。然而，这些方法未能捕捉梯度的全部动态。在本文中，我们提出了LoRA-GA$^2$，这是一种有效利用多步梯度信息的微调算法。具体而言，我们引入了一种轻量级的多步梯度探测方法，该方法不会产生额外的GPU内存成本，且仅带来微小的计算开销。我们进一步采用基于频谱感知的重要性分配的秩分配和从多步梯度推导出的最优初始化。大量的实验结果表明，LoRA-GA$^2$始终优于现有的LoRA变体，同时保留了原版LoRA的效率优势。例如，在GLUE基准测试中，LoRA-GA$^2$平均超越了领先基线0.66个百分点；在GSM8K和HumanEval上，分别比最强基线高出了1.03和0.87个百分点。

articles.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
articles.abstract: Software increasingly functions as part of the scientific instrument itself, making failures in scientific code capable of compromising not only program behavior but also the evidence underlying scientific conclusions. Yet existing evaluations of coding agents largely emphasize aggregate task success, providing limited insight into why agents fail when repairing scientific software. We introduce \textbf{SWE-bench Science}, a repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering comprising 119 tasks from 98 GitHub repositories across 20 scientific domains. Each task is organized into one of three paradigms: Issue-driven, Expert-exploratory, and Engineering-integration. Even the best-performing agent, \textbf{Claude Code with Opus-5 (max), achieves a pass@1 below 50\%}, highlighting the substantial challenges posed by scientific software engineering. We identify four recurring failure mechanisms: deficits in scientific knowledge or abstraction, misguided exploration or surface-level repair, incomplete repair coverage or system integration, and failures to generalize scientific knowledge beyond observed cases in our analysis. We further conduct a paired ablation that removes explicit scientific guidance while preserving the repository and executable engineering context. The results show that scientific knowledge is not uniformly beneficial: well-grounded information can constrain repair and improve average performance and token efficiency, whereas poorly aligned guidance can induce anchoring and does not necessarily improve exact repair success. Together, SWE-bench Science provides a broad testbed for studying both the capabilities and failure mechanisms of coding agents in scientific software engineering.
articles.titleCn: SWE-bench科学：编程代理能否解决科学中的工程任务？
articles.abstractCn: 软件正越来越多地成为科学仪器本身的一部分，使得科学代码的故障不仅可能影响程序行为，还可能损害支撑科学结论的证据。然而，现有的编码代理评估主要强调整体任务成功率，对于代理在修复科学软件时为何失败，未能提供充分的洞察。我们引入了\textbf{SWE-bench Science}，这是一个科学软件工程领域的仓库级基准，包含来自20个科学领域的98个GitHub仓库中的119个任务。每个任务被组织为三种范式之一：问题驱动、专家探索和工程集成。即使是表现最佳的代理\textbf{Claude Code with Opus-5 (max)}，其pass@1指标也低于50%，凸显了科学软件工程面临的重大挑战。我们识别出四种常见的失败机制：科学知识或抽象的缺陷、误导性的探索或表面级修复、修复覆盖不完整或系统集成不完整，以及未能将科学知识推广到分析中观察到的案例之外。我们进一步进行了一对一消融实验，移除了显式的科学指导，同时保留了仓库和可执行工程上下文。结果表明，科学知识并非总是有益的：扎实的信息可以约束修复并提高平均性能和token效率，而与目标不匹配的指导可能诱导锚定效应，并不一定提高精确修复成功率。综合来看，SWE-bench Science为研究编码代理在科学软件工程中的能力和失败机制提供了一个广泛的测试平台。

articles.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay
articles.abstract: Audited against policy-conditional ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals we audit -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control. Correcting for replay-target reliability leaves implicit fidelity bounded near zero and judge fidelity inconclusive at the achieved target reliability. Existing evaluations grade these signals against annotated step *correctness*; we audit them against step *contribution* -- what re-sampling the policy's own alternatives at each decision point and rolling forward changes about the outcome -- and they come apart. The ground truth is structured: 30.5% of decision points where it is defined exhibit a nonzero replay contrast at the achieved sampling resolution, and measurability is model-dependent -- the fraction of points with no policy-supported counterfactual differs twofold (13.1% vs. 26.8%) between two similar-scale policies. The failure mode is identifiable: implicit credit echoes the policy's fluency (median rank correlation +0.75, replicating at +0.70 in a second family under a corrected instrument), while outcome conditioning adds no causal information (partial correlation -0.004, Qwen). A confidence-only router recovers pivotal steps at chance level, but cuts judge cost by 13.1% per turn (14.0% per trajectory). In a seven-arm pre-registered training experiment, no arm reliably outperforms the untrained policy, and the checkpoints' apparent instrument signature is statistically consistent with mediation by effective training dose in this design -- sparser credit retains fewer examples, an order-of-magnitude spread in optimizer steps -- not credit content. Comparisons of credit rules must match effective sample size, or they measure dose, not credit.
articles.comment: 52 pages, 6 figures. Pre-registered; frozen analysis plans and prompts included in the appendices
articles.titleCn: 无真实标签的信用：审计LLM代理的步骤级信用分配针对执行重播
articles.abstractCn: 在单智能体工具环境（ALFWorld）中，针对执行重播生成的策略条件真实数据进行审计，我们发现我们审计的步骤级信用信号——LLM裁判分数、结果条件下的对数概率比率或策略自身的置信度——均未显示出超越其边际匹配随机控制的可靠增量保真度。校正重播目标可靠性后，隐式保真度接近于零，裁判保真度在实现的目标可靠性下仍不确定。现有评估针对标注步骤的*正确性*进行评分；我们则针对步骤的*贡献度*进行审计——即在每个决策点重新采样策略自身的替代方案并向前推进以改变结果——两者存在差异。真实数据结构化：在定义的30.5%决策点中，在实现采样分辨率下表现出非零重播对比，可测量性依赖于模型——两个相似规模策略中无策略支持的反事实点的比例相差两倍（13.1% vs. 26.8%）。失效模式可识别：隐式信用与策略流畅度一致（中位数相关系数+0.75，在修正工具下第二个家族中复制为+0.70），而结果条件化未提供因果信息（偏相关系数-0.004，Qwen）。仅置信度的路由器在偶然水平上恢复关键步骤，但每回合裁判成本降低13.1%（每轨迹降低14.0%）。在一个七臂预注册训练实验中，没有一臂可靠地优于未经训练的策略，检查点的明显工具特征在设计中与有效训练剂量中介一致——稀疏信用保留较少示例，优化器步数差异达一个数量级——而非信用内容。信用规则的比较必须匹配有效样本量，否则它们衡量的是剂量而非信用。

articles.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
articles.abstract: Long-context modeling is a pivotal capability for Large Language Models, yet the quadratic complexity of attention remains a critical bottleneck, particularly during the compute-intensive prefilling phase. Our previous work, FlashPrefill, mitigates this cost through instantaneous pattern discovery and max-based dynamic thresholding; however, it remains an algorithmic prototype that is still distant from production deployment. In this paper, we present FlashPrefill V2, which evolves FlashPrefill from a prototype toward practical long-context serving along three dimensions. First, we introduce a mean correction term that effectively suppresses the approximation error, keeping performance degradation manageable even at extreme sparsity levels. Second, we redesign the sparse attention operator with PackGQA memory access, warp specialization, and pingpong pipelining, fully aligning with the latest FlashAttention-3/4 implementations and supporting FP8 inference to meet practical quantization requirements. Third, FlashPrefill V2 natively supports paged KV cache and continuous batching, allowing integration as an attention backend in modern inference frameworks such as SGLang. Extensive evaluations on NVIDIA H20 GPUs---among the most widely deployed inference accelerators---demonstrate that FlashPrefill V2 delivers up to 47.26x and 27.19x speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 128K context length under FP8 and BF16 precision, respectively, and, in FP8, still achieves a 30.49x speedup against an FA3/4-aligned dense baseline.
articles.titleCn: FlashPrefill V2：面向长上下文大语言模型服务的块稀疏预填充注意力机制
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文建模是大型语言模型的关键能力，但注意力机制的二次复杂度仍然是一个关键瓶颈，尤其是在计算密集型的预填充阶段。我们之前的工作FlashPrefill通过即时模式发现和基于最大值的动态阈值来降低这一成本；然而，它仍然是一个算法原型，距离生产部署还有很长的路要走。在本文中，我们提出了FlashPrefill V2，它在三个维度上将FlashPrefill从原型发展为实用的长上下文服务。首先，我们引入了一个均值校正项，有效地抑制了近似误差，即使在极端稀疏水平下也能保持性能下降在可控范围内。其次，我们重新设计了稀疏注意力算子，采用PackGQA内存访问、warp专用化和pingpong流水线，完全符合最新的FlashAttention-3/4实现，并支持FP8推理以满足实际量化要求。第三，FlashPrefill V2原生支持分页KV缓存和连续批处理，允许其作为注意力后端集成到现代推理框架（如SGLang）中。在NVIDIA H20 GPU（目前最广泛部署的推理加速器之一）上的大量评估表明，FlashPrefill V2在128K上下文长度下，分别以FP8和BF16精度，比FlashAttention-2实现了高达47.26倍和27.19倍的速度提升，并且在FP8精度下，相对于与FA3/4对齐的密集基线，仍然实现了30.49倍的速度提升。

articles.title: Truncate Bad, Upweight Good: BoN-Style Distillation via Rank-Based Classification
articles.abstract: Inference-time selection methods, such as Best-of-N, improve generation by sampling a pool of candidates and selecting the top-ranked completion according to a reward model. Distillation seeks to amortize this procedure into a single policy by replacing raw rewards with in-pool ranks and learning a policy that upweights higher-ranked completions. However, existing rank-based policies typically use smooth full-support reweighting, so low-ranked completions receive less mass but remain in the target support. Although a sharper reweighting reduces lower-tail mass, it also increases reliance on brittle ranking at the top made by a single reward model. We propose TUP: a Truncate-bad, Upweight-good Policy that removes low-ranked completions from the support and reweights only the retained upper tail with a tunable sharpness. TUP admits a closed-form, prompt-independent normalization and can be trained fully offline via binary cross-entropy, using shifted-truncated win-rates as soft labels and distilled-to-reference log-likelihood ratios as logits. Theoretically, under certain assumptions, we show that for any unknown oracle reward, the best monotone rank-reweighting can be matched by a lower-tail truncation rule, providing formal support for removing the lower tail rather than merely downweighting it. Empirically, we show that TUP is competitive with strong offline alignment baselines.
articles.titleCn: 截断坏的，提升好的：基于排名分类的BoN风格蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 推理时选择方法，如最佳N选一，通过采样一组候选并依据奖励模型选择排名最高的完成结果来提升生成效果。知识蒸馏旨在将此流程简化为单一策略，通过用池内排名替代原始奖励，并学习一个能提升高排名完成结果权重的策略。然而，现有的基于排名的策略通常采用平滑全支持重加权，因此低排名完成结果虽然权重较低，但仍然保留在目标支持集中。尽管更锐利重加权能减少低尾部权重，但它也增加了对单一奖励模型在顶部做出的脆弱排名的依赖。我们提出了TUP：一个截断坏的、提升好的策略，它将低排名完成结果从支持集中移除，并仅对保留的上尾部进行可调锐利重加权。TUP允许采用与提示无关的闭式归一化，并且可以通过二元交叉熵完全离线训练，使用位移截断胜率作为软标签，以及蒸馏到参考的对数似然比作为逻辑值。理论上，在特定假设下，我们证明了对于任何未知的神谕奖励，最佳单调排名重加权可以被下尾部截断规则匹配，从而为移除低尾部而非仅降低其权重提供了理论支持。实证上，我们证明了TUP与强大的离线对齐基线具有竞争力。

articles.title: PersonalBench: Measuring the Authorship Gap in LLM Personalization
articles.abstract: Personalized text generation aims to make LLMs write in a specific individual's style, yet existing benchmarks measure task accuracy or preference alignment rather than whether the model's output actually resembles the target author's writing. We introduce PersonalBench, a benchmark that evaluates inference-time personalization methods through three independent lenses: LUAR (a trained authorship verification model), an LLM-as-judge, and automated stylometrics. Across 50 authors, 1,000 generations, and two model families (Qwen 3, GLM-4), we find that personalization methods do produce author-differentiated output (LUAR discriminates target authors within generated text at AUC=0.918) but this differentiation never crosses the human-LLM boundary. All methods achieve LUAR similarity to real authors in the range 0.484-0.508, below the cross-author human floor of 0.626 (ceiling 0.756). The LLM's own authorship fingerprint dominates: generated text is more distant from any human author than random humans are from each other. Methods are statistically indistinguishable from each other on LUAR (spread 0.024) despite appearing differentiated on the LLM judge, a discrepancy we trace to circularity between trait extraction and profile extraction. We validate that LUAR reliably measures authorship in our corpus (AUC=0.76 single-post, 0.96 multi-post). We release PersonalBench as a calibrated measuring stick: inference-time personalization modulates the LLM's style but does not bridge the gap to human authorship.
articles.titleCn: PersonalBench：衡量LLM个性化中的作者差距
articles.abstractCn: 个性化文本生成旨在使大型语言模型以特定个人的风格写作，然而现有的基准测试主要衡量任务准确率或偏好一致性，而非模型输出是否真正类似于目标作者的风格。我们引入了PersonalBench基准，该基准通过三个独立的视角评估推理时的个性化方法：LUAR（一个经过训练的作者身份验证模型）、将大型语言模型作为评判者，以及自动化的文体计量学。在50位作者、1000次生成和两个模型家族（Qwen 3、GLM-4）的测试中，我们发现个性化方法确实产生了区分不同作者的输出（LUAR在生成文本中区分目标作者的能力达到AUC=0.918），但这种区分从未跨越人与大型语言模型之间的界限。所有方法在LUAR相似度上均达到0.484-0.508的范围，低于跨作者的人类基准0.626（上限0.756）。大型语言模型自身的作者身份指纹占主导地位：生成的文本与任何人类作者的距离都大于随机人类之间的距离。尽管在大型语言模型评判者上表现出差异，但所有方法在LUAR上的表现统计上无法区分（差异范围0.024），这种差异我们归因于特征提取与画像提取之间的循环依赖。我们验证了LUAR在我们的语料库中可靠地衡量作者身份（单篇帖子AUC=0.76，多篇帖子AUC=0.96）。我们发布PersonalBench作为一个校准的测量工具：推理时的个性化方法调整了大型语言模型的风格，但并未弥合与人类作者身份之间的差距。

articles.title: One Success Isn't Reliability: Thinkingbox, a Sandbox and Benchmark for Agents in Stateful Business Workflows
articles.abstract: Recent agent benchmarks increasingly ground evaluation in executable environments, from code repair to web navigation, app APIs, and function calling. Yet completing consequential work beyond code requires more than producing a plausible response or valid tool call: agents must gather missing information over multiple turns, follow domain policies, coordinate dependent tools, and realize the correct persistent state transition without collateral effects. In this paper, we introduce Thinkingbox, a sandbox for tool-agent-user interaction that provides isolated MCP-compatible tool sessions, complete execution traces, and outcome evaluation over terminal backend state. Built on this sandbox, Thinkingbox-bench contains 507 policy-conditioned workflows across numerous scenarios, including retail, hospitality, auto insurance, neobank internal IT, and consulting IT/HR support. Each attempt is evaluated by task-specific executable checks that accept valid trajectories while rejecting wrong, missing, or extra effects; designated tasks additionally check required properties of the final response. Across proprietary and open-weight models, the strongest achieves 65.36% pass@1, but only 25.25% pass^20. Moreover, many failed trials show clean termination and valid state-changing actions, showing that response or tool-call-level signals are not clear proxies for end-to-end task completion. Thinkingbox-bench reveals a large gap between occasionally finding a successful trajectory and reliably completing stateful business tasks. We release both Thinkingbox and Thinkingbox-Bench: https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox
articles.titleCn: 一次成功并不代表可靠性：为状态化业务流程中的代理提供沙盒和基准测试的Thinkingbox
articles.abstractCn: 近期的智能体基准测试越来越多地将评估建立在可执行环境中，从代码修复到网页导航、应用程序API和函数调用。然而，要完成超出代码的实质性工作，仅仅生成一个合理的回复或有效的工具调用是不够的：智能体必须在多轮中收集缺失信息，遵循领域策略，协调依赖的工具，并实现正确的持久状态转换而不产生附带影响。在本文中，我们介绍了Thinkingbox，一个用于工具-智能体-用户交互的沙盒，它提供隔离的MCP兼容工具会话、完整的执行轨迹以及通过终端后端状态进行结果评估。基于这个沙盒，Thinkingbox-bench包含了507个跨多个场景的策略条件工作流，包括零售、酒店、汽车保险、新型银行内部IT以及咨询IT/HR支持。每次尝试都通过特定任务的执行检查进行评估，这些检查接受有效的轨迹而拒绝错误、缺失或额外的效果；指定的任务还会检查最终回复所需的属性。在专有和开放权重模型中，最强的模型实现了65.36%的pass@1，但只有25.25%的pass^20。此外，许多失败的尝试显示了干净的终止和有效的状态改变动作，表明回复或工具调用级别的信号并不是端到端任务完成的明确指标。Thinkingbox-bench揭示了在偶尔找到一个成功轨迹和可靠完成状态化业务任务之间存在巨大差距。我们发布了Thinkingbox和Thinkingbox-Bench：https://github.com/microsoft/thinkingbox

articles.title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attack against Large Vision-Language Models via Subtitle Scheduling
articles.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding and reasoning. Despite extensive studies on text- and image-based jailbreaks, video jailbreaks against LVLMs remain largely unexplored. Existing video jailbreak methods mainly manipulate textual content embedded in videos, while overlooking how such information is organized over time. Our analysis reveals that jailbreak effectiveness depends not only on the semantics of textual information but also on its temporal presentation, including duration and timing-slot allocation. Motivated by this finding, we use subtitles, which are common in real-world videos and allow semantic content to be presented under precise temporal control without appearing visually intrusive, as a natural attack medium. Based on this insight, we propose TempJail, a black-box video-based jailbreak framework that constructs query-aligned dialogue-style subtitle sequences and optimizes their temporal scheduling to exploit temporal vulnerabilities in LVLMs and elicit responses that satisfy the harmful intent of the source query. Extensive experiments on four representative LVLMs and two datasets demonstrate that TempJail achieves the highest attack success rate across all evaluated model--dataset settings, outperforming the strongest baseline by 53 and 18 percentage points in dataset-averaged ASR on GPT-5 and Gemini 3.5-Flash, respectively.
articles.titleCn: TempJail：基于字幕调度的针对大型视觉语言模型的时序越狱攻击
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在视频理解和推理方面取得了显著进展。尽管针对文本和图像的越狱攻击已得到广泛研究，但针对LVLMs的视频越狱攻击仍基本未得到探索。现有的视频越狱方法主要操纵视频中嵌入的文本内容，而忽略了此类信息随时间组织的规律。我们的分析表明，越狱攻击的有效性不仅取决于文本信息的语义，还取决于其时间呈现方式，包括持续时间和时间槽分配。基于这一发现，我们利用字幕——现实世界视频中常见的元素，它允许在精确的时间控制下呈现语义内容且不显得视觉干扰——作为自然攻击媒介。基于这一见解，我们提出了TempJail，这是一个基于视频的黑盒越狱框架，该框架构建与查询对齐的对话式字幕序列，并优化其时间调度，以利用LVLMs的时间漏洞并诱使其产生满足源查询有害意图的响应。在四个代表性LVLMs和两个数据集上的大量实验表明，TempJail在所有评估的模型-数据集设置中实现了最高的攻击成功率，在GPT-5和Gemini 3.5-Flash上的数据集平均ASR指标上分别比最强的基线方法高53和18个百分点。

articles.title: Projector Is All You Train
articles.abstract: The typical training process of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) involves adapting both the language model backbone and the projector between the backbone and a modality-specific encoder. We ask whether fine-tuning the backbone of an MLLM is necessary to adapt it to a new modality. Through experiments on 3D MLLMs, we find that training only the projector is sufficient to achieve strong multimodal performance relative to existing baseline models and our jointly trained MLLMs with the same encoder and backbone. We also show that joint training leads to undesirable drift in existing capabilities of the language model, which projector-only training avoids by definition. Furthermore, projector-only training has approximately twice the training sample throughput of joint training. We validate our findings across different language model backbones via 3D classification and captioning benchmarks as well as standard benchmarks evaluating language, vision, and spatial reasoning capabilities.
articles.titleCn: 投影仪就是你训练的全部
articles.abstractCn: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的典型训练过程涉及调整语言模型主干和主干与特定模态编码器之间的投影器。我们探讨了是否需要对MLLM的主干进行微调以适应新模态。通过对3D MLLM进行的实验，我们发现仅训练投影器就足以相对于现有基线模型以及使用相同编码器和主干的联合训练MLLM实现强大的多模态性能。我们还表明，联合训练会导致语言模型现有能力的不可取漂移，而仅训练投影器则通过定义避免了这种情况。此外，仅训练投影器的训练样本吞吐量大约是联合训练的两倍。我们通过3D分类和描述基准以及评估语言、视觉和空间推理能力的标准基准，在不同的语言模型主干上验证了我们的发现。

articles.title: StreamSoccer: Event-Driven Memory for Streaming Soccer Commentary
articles.abstract: Streaming video understanding requires models to causally update state as video arrives and organize growing history into semantic units that can evolve, persist, and be recalled under bounded computation and memory. This challenge is pronounced in live soccer commentary, where a system must describe completed events, summarize recent play, recall earlier events, or remain silent using only information available before each utterance. We present StreamSoccer, an event-driven system that uses event memory as its intermediate representation. A fixed-budget active memory integrates the stream; completed event states are retained locally and consolidated into retrievable historical records. A unified generator uses current, recent, and historical context to produce three commentary modes, while a rule-assisted scheduler selects a mode or silence. Unlike streaming video-language models organized around frames, visual tokens, or caches, and soccer-commentary methods based on predefined clips or output timestamps, StreamSoccer explicitly models event lifecycles. We construct a three-track streaming soccer commentary dataset and a layered evaluation protocol. At common reference anchors, StreamSoccer obtains CIDEr scores of 38.62, 23.96, and 17.39 for current-event, recent-window, and historical-memory commentary, ranking first on the current-event and historical-memory tracks and second on recent-window. Controlled ablations show that local completed events improve all tracks and that the full system performs best on all three. Across 174 raw-video runs on 58 matches, per-minute RTF p95 ranges from 0.10 to 0.22 without sustained growth with match history. These results indicate that event memory supports streaming soccer commentary across temporal scopes while controlling long-history computation.
articles.titleCn: StreamSoccer：事件驱动内存用于流式足球解说
articles.abstractCn: 流媒体视频理解需要模型在视频到达时因果更新状态，并将不断增长的历史组织成可进化、持续存在且可被回忆的语义单元，所有这一切都在有限的计算和内存约束下完成。这一挑战在实时足球解说中尤为突出，系统必须仅使用每次发言前可用的信息来描述已完成的事件、总结最近的比赛、回忆早期事件或保持沉默。我们提出了StreamSoccer，一个事件驱动的系统，它使用事件记忆作为其中间表示。一个固定预算的主动记忆整合了流媒体；已完成的事件状态被本地保留并整合为可检索的历史记录。一个统一的生成器利用当前、最近和历史背景来产生三种解说模式，而一个基于规则的调度器选择模式或沉默。与围绕帧、视觉标记或缓存组织的流媒体视频语言模型，以及基于预定义片段或输出时间戳的足球解说方法不同，StreamSoccer明确地建模了事件生命周期。我们构建了一个三轨流媒体足球解说数据集和一个分层评估协议。在常见的参考锚点处，StreamSoccer在当前事件解说、最近窗口解说和历史记忆解说中分别获得了38.62、23.96和17.39的CIDEr分数，在当前事件和历史记忆轨道上排名第一，在最近窗口轨道上排名第二。受控的消融实验表明，本地已完成的事件提高了所有轨道，而完整系统在所有三个轨道上表现最佳。在58场比赛的174次原始视频运行中，每分钟RTF p95的范围在0.10到0.22之间，且随着比赛历史的持续增长而未出现持续增长。这些结果表明，事件记忆支持跨时间范围的流媒体足球解说，同时控制了长历史计算。

articles.title: The Asymmetric Harms of LLM Compression
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) compression reduces deployment costs, but standard aggregate metrics like perplexity and accuracy often mask underlying behavioral shifts. In this work, we systematically evaluate 3 LLMs across 11 compression methods to investigate the effects of compression on knowledge retention, model confidence, and social bias. We find that compression disproportionately reduces the relative retention of head knowledge compared to tail knowledge. Furthermore, compressed models often remain substantially confident in their incorrect answers on newly lost knowledge. Finally, we demonstrate that stable aggregate bias scores can conceal substantial, opposing shifts in stereotypical preferences across demographic subgroups. Together, these findings reveal asymmetric behavioral changes that aggregate performance measures fail to capture, highlighting the need for granular evaluation of compressed models before deployment.
articles.titleCn: LLM压缩的非对称性危害
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）的压缩可以降低部署成本，但标准的聚合指标如困惑度和准确率往往掩盖了潜在的行为变化。在这项工作中，我们系统地评估了3个LLM在11种压缩方法下的表现，以研究压缩对知识保留、模型置信度和社会偏见的影响。我们发现，压缩会不成比例地减少头部知识的相对保留率，而尾部知识的保留率则相对较高。此外，压缩后的模型在面临新丧失的知识时，往往仍然对其错误答案保持高度自信。最后，我们证明稳定的聚合偏见分数可能掩盖了不同人口子群体中刻板印象偏好上的显著、相反的变化。综合来看，这些发现揭示了聚合性能指标无法捕捉到的非对称行为变化，突出了在部署压缩模型前进行细致评估的必要性。

articles.title: ReCache: Efficient KV Cache Reuse and Compression for Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Agentic language models repeatedly encode tool and skill schemas that recur across requests in different combinations and orders, preventing standard prefix caching from reusing their key--value (KV) states. We introduce \textbf{ReCache}, a framework for independently caching resource representations while reducing their inference-time computational and memory overhead. Resource-wise attention removes cross-resource interactions and assigns resource-local positions, producing composition-invariant KV blocks. ReCache then restricts resource visibility to contribution-selected layer--KV-head-group routes and retains only invocation-critical fields through structural and semantic pruning. We evaluate ReCache on a benchmark assembled from seven public tool- and skill-use datasets, including resource-disjoint tests. Resource-wise attention matches dense invocation performance (82.3\% versus 82.4\% Inv-F1) while providing a 3.655$\times$ time-to-first-token speedup. The complete framework reduces allocated KV-tensor memory by 92.43\% and accelerates attention by 1.423$\times$. These results show that separating reusable schema encoding from selective resource access substantially reduces agentic inference costs with limited effectiveness loss. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/ReCache.
articles.titleCn: ReCache：面向工具增强型大语言模型代理的高效键值缓存重用与压缩
articles.abstractCn: 代理式语言模型会反复编码在不同请求中以不同组合和顺序重复出现的工具和技能模式，这使得标准的以首部为前缀的缓存无法重用其键值（KV）状态。我们引入了\textbf{ReCache}，这是一个独立缓存资源表示的框架，同时减少其推理时的计算和内存开销。资源式注意力机制移除跨资源交互，并为资源分配局部位置，从而生成组合不变的KV块。ReCache随后将资源可见性限制在贡献选择的层-KV头组路由，并通过结构和语义剪枝仅保留调用关键字段。我们在一个包含七个公开工具和技能使用数据集的基准上评估了ReCache，其中包括资源不交测试。资源式注意力机制在密集调用性能上与密集调用性能相当（82.3%与82.4%的Inv-F1），同时提供了3.655倍的首次令牌时间加速。完整的框架将分配的KV张量内存减少了92.43%，并将注意力加速了1.423倍。这些结果表明，将可重用模式编码与选择性资源访问分离，可以显著降低代理式推理成本，同时有效损失有限。代码可在https://github.com/EIT-NLP/ReCache获取。

articles.title: Can Agent Memory Systems Track Evolving State?
articles.abstract: As LLM-based agents are deployed for longer and higher-stakes tasks, their memory systems continue to have crucial gaps. While existing memory benchmarks focus largely on recall-shaped tasks, we argue an effective memory system must track the evolving state of the world; as facts, constraints, and decisions are revised over a long interaction, answers must reflect the current state and not a superseded one. We define this capability as state tracking and instantiate it in StateMemBench, a benchmark of 234 multi-session scenarios spanning two conversation-length regimes. Its closed-pool grading scores whether an answer reflects the current state, the superseded state, or fails otherwise, separating state-tracking failures from other errors by construction. Our analysis shows that this task is challenging for existing memory systems, retrieval-augmented baselines, and long-context baselines. We then present StateMem, a state-first memory method that explicitly tracks supersession and relational dependencies, and show it improves current-state accuracy over the strongest same-backbone baseline by 1.8x (0.205 -> 0.363) on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and over the strongest memory system by 1.6x (0.149 -> 0.233) on Qwen-3.5-9B, while remaining competitive with the long-context baselines. Finally, we show the same state approach can be applied as a lightweight single-call wrapper over existing memory systems, lifting current-state accuracy by +32 to +67 points on StateMemBench across six memory and retrieval backends. A length- and cost-matched control attributes +15 to +32 of those points to state structure rather than added context.
articles.titleCn: 记忆系统能否跟踪状态演变？
articles.abstractCn: 随着基于LLM的代理被用于更长时间、更高风险的任务，它们的记忆系统仍然存在关键缺陷。虽然现有的记忆基准主要关注召回型任务，但我们认为有效的记忆系统必须追踪世界状态的演变；随着事实、约束和决策在长时间交互中被修订，答案必须反映当前状态而非被取代的状态。我们将这种能力定义为状态追踪，并在StateMemBench中实例化它，这是一个包含234个跨两个对话长度模式的单会话场景基准。其封闭池评分标准判定答案是否反映当前状态、被取代的状态或失败，通过设计将状态追踪失败与其他错误区分开来。我们的分析表明，这项任务对现有的记忆系统、检索增强基线和长上下文基线都具有挑战性。然后，我们提出了StateMem，一种以状态优先的记忆方法，它明确追踪取代关系和依赖关系，并表明它在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上比最强的同骨干基线提高了1.8倍（0.205→0.363），在Qwen-3.5-9B上比最强的记忆系统提高了1.6倍（0.149→0.233），同时仍与长上下文基线保持竞争力。最后，我们展示了相同的状态方法可以作为现有记忆系统的轻量级单次调用包装器应用，在六个记忆和检索后端上，将当前状态准确率提升了+32至+67分。在长度和成本匹配的控制实验中，其中+15至+32分被归因于状态结构而非增加的上下文。

articles.title: Mitigating Identity Essentialism in LLM Agents with Longitudinal Life Trajectories
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable approach to social simulation, but their credibility depends on how agents are constructed. Existing methods can partially reproduce population-level patterns, yet often fail to capture human-like diversity. Our analysis shows that static-profile agents exhibit stronger demographic separation and within-group compression than humans, a pattern consistent with identity essentialism: demographic labels can encourage models to treat group-average tendencies as individual traits, homogenizing responses within groups. We argue that this limitation arises from two related factors: sparse, static agent representations and the limited ability of prompt-only memory to persistently integrate experience. Inspired by complementary memory systems, we propose LifeMem, a longitudinal memory framework that combines structured life-event retrieval with agent-specific parametric memory for experience integration. Experiments on Add Health and Understanding Society with three LLMs show that LifeMem improves alignment with human data in terms of response distributions, overall and within-group diversity, and patterns of within-person response change across life stages. These findings highlight the value of longitudinal life-event memory for constructing more faithful and dynamically evolving social agents.
articles.titleCn: 通过纵向生命轨迹减轻大型语言模型代理的身份本质主义
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）为社会模拟提供了一种可扩展的方法，但其可信度取决于智能体的构建方式。现有方法可以部分再现群体层面的模式，但往往无法捕捉类似人类的多样性。我们的分析表明，静态特征智能体表现出比人类更强的社会人口分离和群体内部压缩现象，这一模式与身份本质主义一致：社会人口标签会促使模型将群体平均趋势视为个体特征，从而同质化群体内的响应。我们认为这一局限性源于两个相关因素：稀疏、静态的智能体表征以及仅依赖提示的内存持续整合经验的能力有限。受互补记忆系统的启发，我们提出了LifeMem，一个纵向记忆框架，该框架结合了结构化生命事件检索与特定智能体的参数化记忆以整合经验。在Add Health和Understanding Society数据集上使用三个LLMs进行的实验表明，LifeMem在响应分布、总体和群体内部多样性以及跨生命阶段的个体响应变化模式方面，提高了与人类数据的符合度。这些发现突出了纵向生命事件记忆在构建更忠实、动态演化的社会智能体方面的价值。

articles.title: Forking Fast: Efficiently Estimating Uncertainty Dynamics in Text Generation
articles.abstract: LLM reasoning is stochastic, and so understanding a model requires grappling with the distribution of reasoning chains that it might produce for a given question, i.e., its uncertainty. Resampling-based analyses characterize this distribution, revealing which steps of a rollout determine how the model arrives at its answer. However, a major limitation of these approaches is that resampling text sequences at every token or sentence in a reasoning chain is very costly. Our work strives to make resampling analysis more computationally efficient, while also shedding light on an important scientific question: what is the right statistical model for explaining uncertainty dynamics in text generation? We show that when resampling many reasoning chains, uncertainty dynamics converge to stable patterns, and noise is largely an artifact of sampling rather than an LLM's sensitivity to each individual token or reasoning step. We develop a statistical model for smoothing noisy low-sample rollout data to better approximate high-sample data, allowing us to significantly cut sampling costs.
articles.titleCn: 快速分支：高效估计文本生成中的不确定性动态
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的推理过程具有随机性，因此理解模型需要应对其针对特定问题可能产生的推理链分布，即其不确定性。基于重采样的分析能够表征这种分布，揭示推理过程中的哪些步骤决定了模型如何得出答案。然而，这些方法的主要局限性在于，在推理链的每个标记或句子中重采样文本序列非常耗时。我们的工作致力于提高重采样分析的计算效率，同时阐明一个重要的科学问题：用于解释文本生成中不确定性动态的正确统计模型是什么？我们证明，当重采样许多推理链时，不确定性动态会收敛到稳定模式，而噪声主要是由采样过程造成的，而非大型语言模型对每个单独标记或推理步骤的敏感性。我们开发了一种统计模型，用于平滑具有噪声的低样本推理数据，以更好地逼近高样本数据，从而显著降低了采样成本。

articles.title: PEA-DPO: Perception-Enhanced Alignment Direct Preference Optimization for MLLMs Alignment
articles.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as an effective approach for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. However, its adaptation to multimodal settings remains unexplored. Through representational analysis, we identify a key limitation in multimodal preference optimization, which we term visual insensitivity: models often fail to distinguish between images and those with critical visual context removed. Our theoretical analysis further uncovers two manifestations of this problem, namely Across-Image Insensitivity and Within-Image Insensitivity. To address these challenges, we propose Perception-Enhanced Alignment DPO (PEA-DPO), a framework for multimodal LLMs alignment, which explicitly leverages visual preference signals to overcome visual insensitivity. We further provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that PEA-DPO provably mitigates both failure modes. Empirical results demonstrate that PEA-DPO enhances sensitivity to visual context while preserving the language modeling capacity of the base model. Evaluations across three hallucination benchmarks using MLLMs of varying scales show that PEA-DPO effectively mitigates visual insensitivity, achieves stronger multimodal alignment, and substantially reduces hallucinations.
articles.titleCn: 感知增强对齐直接偏好优化：用于多语言大语言模型对齐
articles.abstractCn: 直接偏好优化（DPO）已成为一种有效的技术，用于将大型语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好进行对齐。然而，将其应用于多模态场景的研究尚待探索。通过表征分析，我们识别出多模态偏好优化中的一个关键限制，我们称之为视觉不敏感性：模型往往无法区分图像和移除了关键视觉上下文的图像。理论分析进一步揭示了该问题的两种表现形式，即跨图像不敏感性和图像内不敏感性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了感知增强对齐DPO（PEA-DPO），这是一个用于多模态LLM对齐的框架，该框架明确利用视觉偏好信号以克服视觉不敏感性。我们进一步提供了理论分析，证明PEA-DPO能够有效缓解这两种失效模式。实证结果表明，PEA-DPO增强了模型对视觉上下文的敏感性，同时保留了基础模型的语言建模能力。在三个不同规模的多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）上的幻觉基准评估显示，PEA-DPO有效缓解了视觉不敏感性，实现了更强的多模态对齐，并显著减少了幻觉现象。

articles.title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib
articles.abstract: Formal proofs in Lean 4 that pass the kernel's type checker can nonetheless vary widely in quality. We introduce ProofJudge, an agentic LLM-as-judge system that scores formal proof quality along five dimensions beyond correctness: library leverage, automation fit, structural clarity, statement quality, and Mathlib conventions. We evaluate ProofJudge on a novel dataset of 218 declarations drawn from distinct Mathlib PRs. The judge agent is grounded by tool access to the commit the PR is applied to, enabling it to query the library state when scoring. A judge is considered aligned with human preferences when it rates the version of the PR Mathlib accepted above the initial version that was sent back for revision. All six judge models evaluated recover the reviewers' preference well above chance, from 80.8% to 63.5%, and two open-weight judges reach roughly 70% at a tenth of the best judge's cost. We release the judge harness, evaluation dataset, and evaluation traces as open-source artifacts to support further research.
articles.titleCn: ProofJudge：基于工具的LLM评估Mathlib中形式证明的质量
articles.abstractCn: 在Lean 4中，通过内核类型检查的正式证明在质量上可能差异很大。我们引入了ProofJudge，这是一个代理式LLM作为评判者的系统，它从正确性之外五个维度对正式证明质量进行评分：库利用、自动化适配性、结构清晰度、陈述质量以及Mathlib规范。我们在一个包含218个声明的新数据集上评估了ProofJudge，这些声明来自不同的Mathlib PR。评判代理通过工具访问PR所应用的提交，使其能够在评分时查询库状态。当评判者将PR被Mathlib接受的版本评分高于最初被退回修改的版本时，该评判者被认为与人类偏好一致。所有六个评判模型均以远超随机水平的准确度恢复了审阅者的偏好，准确率从80.8%到63.5%不等，其中两个开放权重评判者在最佳评判者成本十分之一的情况下达到了约70%的准确率。我们发布了评判器框架、评估数据集和评估轨迹作为开源成果，以支持进一步研究。

articles.title: Remember, Verify, or Ask? Cross-Family Evaluation of Memory Commitment in LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Persistent memory can personalize an LLM agent, but an incorrect durable update can silently distort future behavior. We study the memory-clarification boundary: whether interaction-derived information should be persisted, used only in the current context, re-verified, or clarified with the user. MCB contains 140 primary scenarios, split into 70 development and 70 held-out items, plus a separate 70-item contrast set. It evaluates both action labels and structured tool-call selection. Two non-authors independently label the 70 held-out primary and 70 contrast items (97.1% agreement, Cohen's kappa = 0.962); a blind third resolves four disagreements, replacing eight author labels by non-author majority. Across Claude and Qwen, models verify changing facts more reliably than they ask users to resolve ambiguity. Bare Qwen asks on 0/12 clarification items while verifying 12/18 freshness items. Few-shot prompting raises accuracy from 0.557 to 0.771 (paired delta = +0.214, Holm-adjusted exact McNemar p_H = 0.002), yet clarification recall remains 0.333. The policy prompt reduces erroneous persistence from 0.243 to 0.100 (p_H = 0.038), although its accuracy gain is not significant. Label-tool agreement is 57% for each Claude model and 23% for Qwen; Qwen accuracy falls from 0.557 to 0.343 (p_H = 0.047). Memory evaluation must test both stated decisions and tool-call choices.
articles.titleCn: 记住、验证还是询问？跨家族评估大型语言模型代理中的记忆承诺
articles.abstractCn: 持久化存储可以个性化大型语言模型代理，但错误的持久化更新可能会无声地扭曲未来的行为。我们研究了记忆澄清边界：交互衍生信息是否应该被持久化、仅用于当前上下文、重新验证或向用户澄清。MCB包含140个初始场景，分为70个开发集和70个保留集，外加一个独立的70项对比集。它评估了动作标签和结构化工具调用选择。两位非作者独立标注了70个保留的初始项和70个对比项（97.1%的协议率，Cohen's kappa = 0.962）；一位盲法第三者解决了四个分歧，用非作者多数意见替换了八个作者标签。在Claude和Qwen上，模型验证改变事实比要求用户解决模糊性更可靠。纯Qwen在0/12个澄清项上请求澄清，而在12/18个新鲜项上验证。少样本提示将准确率从0.557提高到0.771（配对增量=+0.214，Holm调整精确McNemar p_H = 0.002），但澄清召回率仍为0.333。策略提示将错误持久化从0.243降至0.100（p_H = 0.038），尽管其准确率提升并不显著。标签-工具协议率对Claude模型为57%，对Qwen为23%；Qwen的准确率从0.557降至0.343（p_H = 0.047）。记忆评估必须同时测试声明决策和工具调用选择。

articles.title: Reliable Financial Named Entity Recognition Under Domain Shift: Confidence Estimation and Selective Prediction
articles.abstract: Financial AI systems often train information extractors on one textual register and deploy them across filings, news, and user-generated content, and standard F1 scores do not indicate which predictions remain safe to automate when that input distribution changes. We study confidence estimation and selective prediction for financial named entity recognition (NER) on a three-tier stress test spanning SEC filings, financial news, and general-topic social media as an extreme out-of-domain condition, evaluating a BERT tagger and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B models with five inference-time confidence signals, three training seeds, and bootstrap intervals. Confidence rankings themselves change under shift: whole-output probability is the strongest in-domain error detector but deteriorates out of domain, whereas entity-span probability and self-consistency are more robust; self-consistency is also better calibrated without post-hoc fitting. Abstention reduces sentence error from 34.3% to below 2% on the highest-confidence 40% of in-domain inputs and remains useful on financial news, but recovers no usefully large clean subset under the extreme social-media shift. These results motivate a staged deployment strategy that detects severe distribution shift upstream before applying prediction-level confidence gating.
articles.titleCn: 领域迁移下的可靠金融实体识别：置信度估计与选择性预测
articles.abstractCn: 金融AI系统通常在一个文本语域上训练信息提取器，并将其部署到申报文件、新闻和用户生成内容中，而标准的F1分数并不能指示当输入分布变化时哪些预测仍然可以自动化。我们研究在涵盖SEC申报文件、金融新闻和一般主题社交媒体的三层压力测试下，金融命名实体识别（NER）的置信度估计和选择性预测，将其作为极端域外条件，评估了BERT标注器和LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B模型，结合了五种推理时置信度信号、三种训练种子和自助抽样区间。置信度排名本身会随分布变化而变化：整体输出概率是领域内最强的错误检测器，但在域外性能下降，而实体跨度概率和自洽性更稳健；自洽性在无需后处理拟合的情况下也进行了更好的校准。弃权策略将领域内最高置信度40%输入的句子错误率从34.3%降至低于2%，并在金融新闻中仍然有效，但在极端社交媒体偏移下未能恢复出有意义的干净子集。这些结果促使我们采用分阶段部署策略，在应用预测级置信度门控之前先检测上游的严重分布偏移。

articles.title: Generating Diverse Personas for User Simulators to Test Interview Dialogue Systems
articles.abstract: This paper addresses the issue of the significant labor required to test interview dialogue systems. While interview dialogue systems are expected to be useful in various scenarios, like other dialogue systems, testing them with human users requires significant effort and cost. Therefore, testing with user simulators can be beneficial. Since most conventional user simulators have been primarily designed for training task-oriented dialogue systems, little attention has been paid to the personas of the simulated users. During development, testing interview dialogue systems requires simulating a wide range of user behaviors, but manually creating a large number of personas is labor-intensive. We propose a method that automatically generates personas for user simulators using a large language model. Furthermore, by assigning personality traits related to communication styles when generating personas, we aim to increase the diversity of communication styles in the user simulator. Experimental results show that the proposed method enables the user simulator to generate utterances with greater variation.

articles.titleCn: 为用户模拟器生成多样化角色以测试面试对话系统
articles.abstractCn: 本文探讨了测试面试对话系统所需的大量劳动问题。尽管面试对话系统预期在各种场景中发挥作用，但与其他对话系统一样，通过真人用户进行测试需要大量的努力和成本。因此，使用用户模拟器进行测试可以带来益处。由于大多数传统用户模拟器主要设计用于训练任务导向型对话系统，因此很少关注模拟用户的人格。在开发过程中，测试面试对话系统需要模拟各种用户行为，但手动创建大量用户角色是费力的。我们提出了一种使用大型语言模型自动生成用户模拟器用户角色的方法。此外，在生成用户角色时分配与沟通风格相关的个性特征，旨在增加用户模拟器中沟通风格的多样性。实验结果表明，所提出的方法使用户模拟器能够生成更多样化的语句。

articles.title: PACEShop: Evaluating Personalized, Actionable, Compositional, and Evidence-grounded Shopping Assistants
articles.abstract: Shopping assistants are shifting from ranked product lists toward structured decision support, where systems must synthesize shopper context, product evidence, and next-step guidance into a coherent recommendation experience. This changes the unit of evaluation: a fluent response can still fail by ignoring shopper context, contradicting itself across components, or leaving defects too vague to localize. Existing personalization, grounding, and LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks cover pieces of this problem, but they do not define a joint evaluation target for structured shopping-assistant responses. We formulate this missing evaluation target as PACE: Personalized, Actionable, Compositional, and Evidence-grounded evaluation. We instantiate PACE with two artifacts: PACEShop, a benchmark dataset that makes the target measurable through 22,625 controlled records with structured personas, auditable evidence pools, GOOD/BAD labels, and gold defect family and location annotations; and PACEJudge, a training-free judging protocol that makes the target reportable through a structured output contract. Our experiments show that generic judges can recognize broad quality but fail to recover the diagnostic fields required for PACE; PACEShop makes these failures verifiable, and PACEJudge improves persona-source, cross-component, grounding, and family/location closure without retraining, showing that realistic shopping-assistant evaluation requires a task-matched output contract rather than only a stronger backbone or scalar prompt.
articles.titleCn: PACEShop：评估个性化、可操作、组合式和基于证据的购物助手
articles.abstractCn: 购物助手正从排序的产品列表转向结构化决策支持，在此过程中，系统必须将购物者上下文、产品证据和下一步指导整合为连贯的推荐体验。这改变了评估单元：流畅的响应仍可能因忽略购物者上下文、组件间自相矛盾或缺陷过于模糊无法定位而失败。现有的个性化、基础和LLM作为裁判的基准测试涵盖了该问题的部分内容，但它们并未定义结构化购物助手响应的联合评估目标。我们将这一缺失的评估目标形式化为PACE：个性化、可行动、组合性和证据基础的评估。我们通过两个实例化艺术品来体现PACE：PACEShop，一个基准数据集，通过22,625条受控记录，包含结构化角色、可审计证据库、GOOD/BAD标签以及黄金缺陷家族和位置注释，使目标可衡量；以及PACEJudge，一个无需训练的裁判协议，通过结构化输出合同使目标可报告。我们的实验表明，通用裁判可以识别广泛的质量，但无法恢复PACE所需的诊断字段；PACEShop使这些失败可验证，而PACEJudge在不重新训练的情况下改进了角色来源、跨组件、基础和家族/位置闭合，表明真实的购物助手评估需要与任务匹配的输出合同，而不仅仅是更强的骨干或标量提示。

articles.title: From Retrieved Context to Runtime Control: Adaptive Compression for Edge-based RAG
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language-model responses by grounding generation in external passages, which comes with overhead: retrieved context lengthens the prompt, increasing prefill work, KV-cache footprint, memory traffic, latency, and energy. Context compression offers a natural remedy by pruning retrieved text before generation. However, state-of-the-art context-compression methods are typically used with a fixed compression budget, or with the rate selected offline and then applied at inference time. This static view ignores both workload variation and the live state of the edge device. On an edge SoC, compression is not free: the compressor itself runs on the same SoC and consumes latency and energy that can offset any generation savings. This paper proposes a vision for telemetry-informed adaptive compression in edge RAG, grounded in experimental evidence. We characterize the compression tradeoff on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor using Llama and Qwen generators, Natural Questions and HotpotQA datasets, and LLMLingua-2 compression. Our measurements show that generation dominates the RAG budget for larger models, reaching roughly 90% of per-query latency and 91% of GPU energy for 7B-8B generators. Exploring the impact of the compression rate reveals an adaptive operating region: mild compression can miss energy opportunities, and overly aggressive compression can hurt inference quality. Intermediate compression can reduce GPU energy by up to 53.2%, and SoC energy by up to 48.2%, with negligible quality loss. We argue for runtime policies that dynamically manage compression, guided by workload features and edge telemetry.

articles.titleCn: 从检索上下文到运行时控制：基于边缘的RAG的自适应压缩
articles.abstractCn: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将生成与外部段落相结合来改进语言模型的响应，但这带来了开销：检索到的上下文延长了提示，增加了预填充工作、KV缓存占用、内存流量、延迟和能耗。上下文压缩提供了一种自然的解决方案，通过在生成前修剪检索到的文本。然而，最先进的上下文压缩方法通常使用固定的压缩预算，或是在离线选择压缩率然后在推理时应用。这种静态观点忽略了工作负载的变化和边缘设备的实时状态。在边缘SoC上，压缩并非免费：压缩器本身也在同一SoC上运行，并消耗可能抵消任何生成节省的延迟和能耗。本文提出了一种基于实验证据的边缘RAG中的遥测信息自适应压缩愿景。我们使用Llama和Qwen生成器、自然问题和HotpotQA数据集以及LLMLingua-2压缩，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor上表征了压缩权衡。我们的测量表明，对于较大的模型，生成主导了RAG预算，对于7B-8B生成器，每查询延迟的约90%和GPU能耗的91%都由生成主导。探索压缩率的影响揭示了自适应操作区域：轻微压缩会错失能耗机会，而过于激进的压缩会损害推理质量。中等压缩可将GPU能耗降低高达53.2%，将SoC能耗降低高达48.2%，且质量损失可以忽略不计。我们主张采用由工作负载特征和边缘遥测引导的运行时策略来动态管理压缩。

articles.title: When Machines Speak: A Unified Generative Framework for Integrating Machine-Native Symbols into Pretrained Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Many real-world AI systems represent entities, behaviors, and structured information using discrete machine-native symbols rather than natural language. While these representations are compact and preserve task-relevant structure, they lie outside the linguistic token space of pretrained large language models (LLMs), creating a fundamental divide between language modeling and structured prediction. We introduce UniLang, a unified generative framework that bridges this divide by extending pretrained LLMs to treat machine-native symbols as first-class generative units alongside natural-language tokens. UniLang expands the LLM's vocabulary and embedding space with grounded machine-native representations, enabling textual and symbolic tokens to be jointly modeled and generated under a single autoregressive objective. This unified interface allows pretrained LLMs to directly operate on machine-native representations without requiring them to be verbalized as natural language or relying on task-specific architectures. We evaluate UniLang on two structurally distinct tasks, sequential recommendation and legal precedent prediction, spanning different domains and types of structured prediction. Across both tasks, UniLang consistently outperforms strong baselines, demonstrating a path toward extending pretrained LLMs beyond language and using them as a common generative modeling backbone for heterogeneous machine-native representations.
articles.titleCn: 当机器发声：一种整合机器原生符号到预训练大型语言模型的统一生成框架
articles.abstractCn: 许多现实中的AI系统使用离散的机器原生符号来表示实体、行为和结构化信息，而非自然语言。尽管这些表示方式紧凑且保留了任务相关的结构，但它们超出了预训练大型语言模型（LLM）的词汇空间，从而在语言建模和结构化预测之间造成了根本性的鸿沟。我们引入了UniLang，这是一个统一的生成式框架，通过扩展预训练的LLM，将机器原生符号视为与自然语言符号同等的第一类生成单元，以此弥合这一鸿沟。UniLang通过引入基于机器原生的表示方式扩展了LLM的词汇和嵌入空间，使得文本和符号可以联合建模和生成，并遵循单一的自回归目标。这种统一的接口允许预训练的LLM直接操作机器原生表示，无需将其转化为自然语言或依赖特定任务的架构。我们在两个结构上截然不同的任务——序列推荐和法律先例预测——上评估了UniLang，这些任务涵盖了不同领域和类型的结构化预测。在两个任务中，UniLang始终优于强大的基线模型，展示了将预训练的LLM扩展至语言之外，并使其成为异构机器原生表示的通用生成式建模骨干的路径。

articles.title: Does Listening Matter? Backchanneling and Nodding in AI Clone
articles.abstract: AI clones that imitate a specific person typically reproduce what the person says and how they sound, but not how they listen. We investigate whether adding multimodal listening behaviors gives such a clone more presence and authenticity. We integrated verbal backchannels and head nodding, driven by real-time prediction models, into an AI clone equipped with voice cloning and LLM-based responses. In a within-subjects study (N=35), adding these behaviors significantly improved the perceived attentiveness of the avatar, the sense of talking with the real person, and the feeling of co-presence. These results indicate that AI clone fidelity should extend beyond voice and response content to include interactive listening behavior.

articles.titleCn: 倾听重要吗？AI克隆中的反馈信号和点头
articles.abstractCn: 模仿特定人物的AI克隆通常能复制对方的话语和声音，但无法复制对方的倾听方式。我们研究了增加多模态倾听行为是否能让这样的克隆更具临场感和真实感。我们将由实时预测模型驱动的言语反馈和点头动作整合到具备语音克隆和基于LLM的回应的AI克隆中。在一项被试内研究（N=35）中，添加这些行为显著提升了虚拟形象被感知的专注度、与真人对话的感觉以及临场感。这些结果表明，AI克隆的真实性不应仅限于语音和回应内容，还应包括互动式倾听行为。

articles.title: Automated Summarization of Financial News Using Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation: An Early Empirical Study (Fall 2023)
articles.abstract: Stock market analysts and investors face a daily challenge: too much financial news, too little time. Manually reading and synthesizing hundreds of company-specific articles is impractical, yet missing key information can directly affect investment decisions. This project, conducted at George Washington University in Fall 2023, explores whether Large Language Models can automate this process reliably. We built a pipeline that pulls news articles from the News API, company background from Wikipedia, and stock price data from Yahoo Finance for ten major companies (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, JPM, NVDA, WMT, DIS). Because LLMs cannot directly process numerical tables, we developed a simple but effective template that converts stock data into natural language narratives. We then tested two summarization approaches (Summarize Chains and Retrieval-Augmented Generation with FAISS) across three open-source models (Falcon-7B-Instruct, DistilBART-CNN-12-6, BART-Large-XSum) for news, and GPT (text-davinci-003) for stock summaries. Falcon-7B with Summarize Chains gave the best results, covering all news events accurately and coherently. RAG, while promising in theory, caused severe repetition in Falcon and hallucinated facts in BART-Large when k was large. Both LLM-based approaches outperformed a simple Lead-3 baseline on ROUGE-1. We also built a Streamlit dashboard for interactive stock visualization. The work was done in Fall 2023, before RAG-based financial tools became widespread, and the failure modes we document, particularly hallucination under RAG in smaller models, remain relevant today.

articles.titleCn: 使用大型语言模型和检索增强生成技术自动总结金融新闻：一项早期实证研究（2023年秋季）
articles.abstractCn: 股票市场分析师和投资者每天都面临一个挑战：金融新闻太多，时间太少。手动阅读和综合数百篇公司特定文章是不切实际的，但遗漏关键信息会直接影响投资决策。这项在2023年秋季乔治华盛顿大学进行的项目探索了大型语言模型是否能够可靠地自动化这一过程。我们构建了一个管道，从新闻API获取新闻文章，从维基百科获取公司背景信息，从雅虎财经获取十家主要公司（AAPL、MSFT、GOOGL、AMZN、META、TSLA、JPM、NVDA、WMT、DIS）的股价数据。由于大型语言模型不能直接处理数值表格，我们开发了一个简单但有效的模板，将股价数据转换为自然语言叙述。然后，我们针对新闻测试了两种摘要方法（Summarize Chains和基于FAISS的检索增强生成），针对三种开源模型（Falcon-7B-Instruct、DistilBART-CNN-12-6、BART-Large-XSum），以及针对股价摘要的GPT（text-davinci-003）。Falcon-7B配合Summarize Chains取得了最佳结果，准确且连贯地涵盖了所有新闻事件。虽然基于FAISS的检索增强生成在理论上很有前景，但在Falcon模型中导致严重重复，在BART-Large中k值较大时产生事实性幻觉。基于大型语言模型的两种方法在ROUGE-1指标上均优于简单的Lead-3基线。我们还构建了一个用于交互式股价可视化的Streamlit仪表板。这项工作是在2023年秋季完成的，当时基于检索增强生成金融工具尚未普及，我们记录的失败模式，特别是小模型在检索增强生成下的幻觉问题，至今仍具有相关性。

articles.title: Hear2Act: Benchmarking When Prosody Should Change What an Assistant Does
articles.abstract: Prosodic cues can convey task-relevant information that alters the trajectory and outcome of a task-oriented dialogue, even when the words themselves remain unchanged. Yet existing benchmarks typically evaluate prosodic perception, response appropriateness, and task-oriented dialogue in isolation, making it difficult to test whether prosodic evidence changes downstream decisions. We introduce Hear2Act, a unified evaluation protocol for text and spoken assistants with 480 persona-grounded scenarios, hidden user concerns, and objectively verifiable outcomes. For each scenario, we keep the task and user needs fixed while varying whether the same concern is conveyed explicitly in words or primarily through prosody, and evaluate decisions under transcript, audio, and concern-state access. Using Hear2Act, we evaluate two audio-capable LLMs. Under Prosody-mediated feedback, adding audio to the transcript changes the average optimal-solution rate only from 14.6% to 15.3%. In contrast, when models infer the concern status from audio, represent it in text, and use it for next-action selection, the rate rises to 39.6%, close to 40.7% with the ground-truth state. This contrast, however, largely disappears under Explicit lexical feedback, where the concern is verbally mentioned in the utterance. Together, these results show that prosody matters when lexical evidence is insufficient, and that audio-capable LLMs can recover information from speech but do not reliably carry it into action without an explicit intermediate representation.
articles.titleCn: Hear2Act：当语调变化时应如何调整助手的行为——基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 韵律线索可以传递与任务相关的信息，即使词语本身保持不变，也能改变面向任务的对话轨迹和结果。然而，现有的基准通常孤立地评估韵律感知、响应恰当性以及面向任务的对话，这使得难以测试韵律证据是否会影响下游决策。我们引入了 Hear2Act，这是一个用于文本和语音助手的统一评估协议，包含 480 个基于角色设定的场景、隐藏的用户关切以及客观可验证的结果。在每个场景中，我们保持任务和用户需求固定，同时改变同一关切是显式地通过词语传达还是主要通过韵律传达，并在文本转录、音频和关切状态访问下评估决策。使用 Hear2Act，我们评估了两个具备音频功能的 LLM。在韵律介导的反馈下，将音频添加到文本转录中仅将平均最优解率从 14.6% 提升至 15.3%。相比之下，当模型从音频中推断关切状态，将其表示为文本，并用于选择下一步行动时，该率上升至 39.6%，接近 40.7% 的真实状态。然而，这种对比在显式词汇反馈下基本消失，其中关切在话语中通过词语明确提及。综合这些结果表明，当词汇证据不足时韵律很重要，并且具备音频功能的 LLM 能够从语音中恢复信息，但在没有显式中间表示的情况下，它们并不能可靠地将这些信息转化为行动。
